name: AerCap Holdings N.V.
fragility_flags: DATA_GAP:capex — capex missing for fiscal year(s) 2023, 2024, 2025 of the last 3 — no tier emitted
STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
BUYBACK_TAILWIND: share count shrinking 9.9%/yr — already credited via the growth adjustment
BASIS_BREAK_SUSPECT: a >60% revenue jump/drop in the last 5 yrs — check for divestitures, big M&A, or restatements before trusting any CAGR
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2024 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

ADS_RATIO_MISSING: 20-F filer — per-share figures are per ordinary share but the traded price is per ADS; make_score refuses (DATA_GAP:ads_ratio) until judgment.json carries an ads_ratio {ratio, source, reason}
note: DATA_GAP: required filing data is missing (see data_gap / data_gap_uncovered). v5 never emits a tier on an uncovered data gap — a missing value is not a zero.
